design.intent: Teach braking and descending alignment in successive lower catch basins, separated by stabilization shelves.
design.signature: A downhill route built around horizontal drops and sloped catches; braking, rather than boosts, sets the pace.

sequence.purpose: Clear runway; show the first lesson before commitment.
Reach the crater rim with an intermediate shelf that settles pitch.
Teach rolling off a horizontal lip into a generous sloped catch.
Give a visible braking cue before the long step-down.
Use a long descending flight to reward deliberate pitch control.
Settle in a broad basin before the deeper drop.
Signal speed reduction before the lower lip.
Apply the learned drop technique to greater vertical separation.
Two low rollers restore a calm forward rhythm.
An optional descending bridge resolves the downhill theme above safe ground.
Empty finish release after the last challenge.
